description: Scrape public TeamBlind discussions without a login. Search by keyword, browse a topic or company, or paste post URLs to get the thread and its public comments.

companies.description: Company slugs as used in TeamBlind URLs, for example `Google`, `Amazon`, `Meta`, `Microsoft`, `Apple`, `Netflix`, `Stripe`.
companies.title: Companies

includeComments.description: Emit each comment the public thread page exposes as its own record. Replies are included with a `depth` and `parentCommentId`.
includeComments.title: Include public comments (thread mode)

includePostDetails.description: Company overview pages already carry the full text of the latest discussions. Turn this on to follow older company-page cards and fetch each post's full body and engagement fields.
includePostDetails.title: Fetch full post details (company mode)

maxItems.description: Hard cap on emitted records. Posts, comments and error records all count toward the cap.
maxItems.sectionDescription: Keep runs small for schedules and raise the limits for one-off research.
maxItems.title: Max records

maxPages.description: Maximum number of listing pages to follow per topic, company or search. The first page is free; each additional page uses TeamBlind's public load-more action.
maxPages.title: Max pages

mode.description: Pick the kind of TeamBlind page to collect.
mode.sectionDescription: TeamBlind's public pages are readable without an account. Choose one mode and fill the matching inputs below.
mode.title: What to scrape

postUrls.description: Post URLs (or 8-character aliases) for the thread mode. The URL mode also accepts channel, company and search URLs.
postUrls.title: Post or TeamBlind URLs

query.description: Keyword used by the search mode. TeamBlind's public search covers post titles and bodies.
query.title: Search keyword

sortBy.description: `recent` shows newest posts, `popular`/`top` shows the most engaged posts. The legacy value `newest` is accepted and treated as `recent`.
sortBy.sectionDescription: Control ordering and how much data is collected.
sortBy.title: Sort order

topics.description: Channel slugs such as `tech`, `layoffs`, `software-engineering`, `relationships`, `stocks-investments`, or a full `/channels/...` URL. The actor normalises names and legacy display labels.
topics.sectionDescription: Fill the input that matches the selected mode.
topics.title: Topics / channels

title: TeamBlind Topics, Companies & Threads Input
